career_ladder.note: Civil Judge (Junior Division) / Judicial Magistrate of First Class is the foundational cadre of the Andhra Pradesh State Judicial Service governed by the Andhra Pradesh State Judicial (Service & Cadre) Rules, 2007. Progression across the judicial hierarchy is regulated by High Court administrative rules and constitutional provisions under Article 233 and Article 217, adhering to Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) scales.

exam_scheme.note: Selection process conducted by the High Court of Andhra Pradesh comprises three successive stages: a Screening Test (Computer Based Test of 100 objective questions for shortlisting in a 1:10 ratio), a Written Examination of 3 descriptive papers (Civil Laws, Criminal Laws, English Translation & Essay Writing, each 100 marks), followed by a Viva-Voce test (50 marks). Final merit is compiled from aggregate marks scored in the Written Examination and Viva-Voce.

stages.source_label: High Court of AP Notification No. 03/2023-RC, Clause VI(a)

papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum 40% qualifying marks; candidates shortlisted in 1:10 ratio for Written Examination

stages.source_label: High Court of AP Notification No. 03/2023-RC, Clause VI(b)

papers.qualifying_threshold: 55% for OC/EWS, 50% for BC, 45% for SC/ST

papers.paper_name: Paper II: Criminal Laws (CrPC, IPC, Indian Evidence Act, NI Act, Domestic Violence Act, Juvenile Justice)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 55% for OC/EWS, 50% for BC, 45% for SC/ST

papers.qualifying_threshold: 55% for OC/EWS, 50% for BC, 45% for SC/ST (Overall aggregate: 60% for OC/EWS, 55% for BC, 50% for SC/ST to qualify for Viva-Voce)

stages.source_label: High Court of AP Notification No. 03/2023-RC, Clause VIII & Clause X

papers.qualifying_threshold: Shortlisting in 1:3 ratio. Minimum aggregate marks in Written + Viva: 60% for OC/EWS, 55% for BC, 50% for SC/ST

financial_package.note: Civil Judges (Junior Division) are remunerated under the Second National Judicial Pay Commission (SNJPC) revised pay scales implemented nationwide pursuant to Supreme Court directives in All India Judges Association v. Union of India. The entry pay scale is ₹77,840 - ₹1,36,520 with an entry basic pay of ₹77,840.
financial_package.pay_source_label: High Court of Andhra Pradesh Notification No. 03/2023-RC dated 07.03.2023 read with SNJPC Recommendations
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated on SNJPC J-1 entry basic pay of ₹77,840 with standardized 58% Dearness Allowance plus HRA / designated judicial bungalow allowance and fixed judicial allowances (sumptuary, robe, medical, conveyance); in-hand estimate deducts 10% NPS/pension contribution, APGLI/GIS, and Professional Tax.
official_perks: Designated government residential bungalow / judicial accommodation or HRA
Conveyance Allowance / official vehicle with driver fuel reimbursement as per SNJPC norms
Sumptuary Allowance for entertaining official judicial visitors
Robe and uniform allowance granted triennially
Telephone, mobile, and high-speed broadband internet reimbursements
Cashless medical coverage under the State Judicial Employees Health Scheme
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and home travel benefits
